summary: Measure property returns, analyse NOI and build portfolio scorecards through practical case exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Real estate portfolio management connects property-level results with investment objectives through cash-flow and return analysis. This intermediate course is for portfolio and asset managers and investment analysts who assess property performance and inform portfolio decisions. Excel-based exercises cover reconciling operating and cash-flow data, comparing NOI and IRR, explaining performance variances, assessing portfolio exposures and prioritizing capital proposals.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with property investment, operating or valuation information and need to connect asset-level evidence to portfolio performance decisions.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of property investment or asset operations, including basic property income and cost measures, is recommended. Bring a laptop with Excel or a compatible spreadsheet application; no programming is required.
